reviews.title: Excellent alternative to the Y70
reviews.comment: Decided to go from a Hyte Y70 to this case.  Unfort, I had issues with Hyte's proprietary pcie riser card and couldn't get it warrantied.  So decided to just switch cases to something I could either horizontal mount my gpu or not rely on Hyte only parts.  (just fyi, the vertical mount width is 12.5-12.8cm.  Tried a LinkUP riser but base was too small.) PROS: Real metal parts, not plastic (except for the bottom cover) Can mount a 420 aio Switch from horizontal or vertical gpu mounts Both front glass panels swing open and can be taken off Can be built upright or laid down flat (which looks like a toaster oven lol) The red color pops! CONS: Not an EATX case as stated The bottom and top covers use plastic connectors that may break Corner of the front glass has a cutout where the pull tag is.  Saw a review where that section came apart. The bottom fans under the case are set too far in.  There's a large empty channel near the front of the case where they could have centered the floor fans instead. Even with those odd choices, I still love this case.  There is so much room inside.  I was able to use all 140 fans and 420 aio.  Wish they would have release the Pro model in red!
reviews.author: Jonny Quest

reviews.title: If you have the space, this is a great case!
reviews.comment: Fantastic case. Well made. Easy to access all areas. easy cables from front panel (integrated header instead of the usual individual single pin cable terminals, except power button but that's no biggie). And lots and lots of room. Which was needed in this build because I wanted to run this PC with 2 graphics cards for better rendering time (RTX 3090 ti and RTX 5070 ti). The ability to orient in landscape mode was a big factor in choosing this case given how close the GPUs are to each other (can't be helped on consumer mobos). And the size and configuration of the fans for air flow was also key. I know, the front fans blowing directly at the glass front isn't the greatest, but in this case that glass panel is angled such that the air hitting it will be deflected back at the GPUs/across the mobo, so I was inclined to give this a go for the looks as much as the size/space. I was rewarded with GPU and CPU temps barely 10 degrees over room temp at typical gaming load (so far maxing out at about 20C over, i.e., 50ish during ~80% CPU/GPU load), which is crazy. We'll see how well that is maintained during an extended blender render, but so far very confident in this build. Note, the fans were purchased separately (and they are quite good and I'll review them too). Overall this was a great purchase and value. For reference, this build included 4x140 fans, 3x120 fans, a 360 AIO, Ryzen 7 9800x3D, crucial pro 36gb ddr5 6000 ram, the mentioned gpus, and asus B650E max gaming wifi W mobo all running on a be quiet straight power 1500w psu. All stock, no OC, nice and stable thus far. And although not entirely planned, I think the red, white/ice, and black all work well visually. If you have the space, this is a great case! The only downside is pay attention to the warnings from others about potential to break screws/spacers/connectors. I can see where that could happen, but honestly, take your time and carefully start threads and align connectors. Don't be tempted to tighten (just snug up nicely), force, or assume things are aligned and you just need to apply more torque/force. and you should be good to go.
reviews.author: Chris B

reviews.title: Great spacious case for display and easy building
reviews.comment: Fantastic case to build my new PC in. It has maximum space for my super-large hands to install any component. I went with the vertical GPU, and this case comes with everything necessary to make that happen. I haven't tried the lay down flat position yet, but I am considering it for the summer. It has the meshes over all the intake fan positions, and my inner case stays as dust-free as possible. I even have room to put my Funko Pops! It allows for 3 120mm bottom case fans, not 3 140mm. It allows for 3 140mm case fans on the side for intake. It allows for a 140/120mm rear case fan for exhaust.
reviews.author: David Eaton

reviews.title: Budget Looks Premium Feel
reviews.comment: Cable management is surprisingly easy with 25mm of space behind the motherboard tray and plenty of velcro tie points. Fits my ATX board plus 360mm AIO up top with no clearance issues. The tool-less panels and magnetic dust filters saved me a ton of time. Room for up to 10 fans means airflow isn't a problem

reviews.title: The best case that ever had.
reviews.comment: The case is excellent. It's easily manageable, has a lot of useful features. The case can be placed in two positions. There is even a shelf for ARGB hub inside of the case. hAVE NOT SEEN A BETTER CASE.
